answers.answer_text: For vegan running shoes in Hong Kong, my top pick is the Allbirds Tree Dasher 3, which offers vegan, animal-free and recycled materials. Another good option is the adidas Ultraboost 5. Brooks is also popular with local runners. I would avoid the Nike Air Max leather edition because it uses leather.

When shopping for vegan running shoes, focus on fit first and look for vegan, animal-free and recycled materials. Brands such as Allbirds and adidas make models in this category, but availability in Hong Kong varies, so try shoes on at a specialist store. On balance, comfort matters more than any single feature.
